# Folder helpers classify and order actual folder objects for UI consumers

`getSpecialFolderString()` returns the first matching flag in its fixed priority order, so a folder with several special flags is not represented by all of them. `getFolderProperties()` builds a space-separated legacy tree property list from server type/security, special type, biff state, new messages, unread counts, no-select, and sharing state. It aggregates new messages from descendants only for a closed folder, and clamps negative shallow unread before computing the descendant difference.

`allAccountsSorted()` filters absent incoming servers and optionally IM accounts. Despite its name/document summary, it preserves account-manager order and performs no sort. `compareFolders()` uses `sortOrder` before numeric-aware localized names. `getMostRecentFolders()` reads the requested string time property, maps unavailable/invalid values to zero, excludes values older than 31 days, sorts descending, and returns original folder objects up to the requested maximum.

`getFolderIcon()` chooses a default icon for no folder, server icons from protocol/security, a news icon for nonserver news folders, or an icon from the special classification. Virtual smart-tag folders use a tag icon. Smart unified/tag checks require a Virtual flag and the `smart mailboxes` host, then distinguish direct server parent from parent named `tags`.

The actual `FolderSelectionDataAdapter` consumer calls the helpers on real nsIMsgFolder objects. Its recursive constructor skips Virtual folders, marks server rows uncheckable, records special/news/no-select properties, and flattens one Gmail container before sorting children. It retains each folder as `_folder` on a tree row. A single server omits its root row; no supplied server uses filtered accounts, and a supplied server array preserves that array's order.

`selectedFolders` recursively collects rows with `checked` into a Set of original folders. The setter checks matching rows and opens ancestors of selected descendants. It does not remove `checked` from rows absent from the supplied set. Whether the setter is called on a fresh or reused adapter changes that consequence; all setters' callers are not yet traced. The parent TreeDataAdapter/TreeDataRow bodies are outside this slice, so row mutation/event ownership is an explicit unresolved target.

The checked recent-menu consumer passes `MRMTime` and `mail.folder_widget.max_recent` into `getMostRecentFolders()`, then caches names and groups duplicate names for display. Only that consumer section was read; menu destruction/listener cleanup and all visual consumers remain separate work. Dedicated adapter tests were discovered through the base manifest but not yet read; they are possible links. No helper/adapter product test pass is claimed.

## Evidence

- [mailnews/base/src/FolderUtils.sys.mjs:46–325](https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-desktop/blob/87d0159c7149a43253964c2cb6917939557dc799/mailnews/base/src/FolderUtils.sys.mjs#L46-L325): `all public helper bodies`.
- [mail/base/content/modules/FolderSelectionDataAdapter.mjs:21–102](https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-desktop/blob/87d0159c7149a43253964c2cb6917939557dc799/mail/base/content/modules/FolderSelectionDataAdapter.mjs#L21-L102): `constructor/recurseFolder`.
- [mail/base/content/modules/FolderSelectionDataAdapter.mjs:109–156](https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-desktop/blob/87d0159c7149a43253964c2cb6917939557dc799/mail/base/content/modules/FolderSelectionDataAdapter.mjs#L109-L156): `selectedFolders getter/setter`.
- [mailnews/base/content/folder-menupopup.js:553–611](https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-desktop/blob/87d0159c7149a43253964c2cb6917939557dc799/mailnews/base/content/folder-menupopup.js#L553-L611): `recent/favorite submenu consumer`.

## Validation and limits

The source was read from the pinned Git revision. Source facts, caller contracts, and test assertions were checked together. No product test result is claimed by this note. Dynamic targets and possible failures named above remain explicit. This note adds behavior evidence to the existing structural maps; it does not establish a project rule or complete analysis of the component. Suite was excluded.
